responsibility: Implements the language-independent built-in preprocessor macro definitions that GCC front ends install when they use cpplib. It derives version components from BASEVER, defines the __GNUC__ and __VERSION__ family, publishes atomic memory-model constants, and emits target- and option-dependent macros for PIC/PIE, sanitizers, optimization and math modes, LP64, endian order, type sizes, pointer size, alignment, and related ABI properties based on GCC option state and target tree/type nodes.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file of the cppbuiltin pair: it computes and installs the predefined macros, including version, atomic-model, optimization, ABI, endian, and type-size macros, from current compiler and target state. Unlike gcc/cppbuiltin.h, it contains the macro-definition logic rather than just the exported entry points.
